question: Does the completed exact-head immutable reconciliation and final release-candidate replay prove complete contribution provenance, self-consistent evidence identity, and acceptable fail-closed release operations?
rationale: The patch becomes the authority for contributor credit and release publication; focused tests cannot safely substitute for maintainer assessment of the real historical release workflow and its changed operator contract.

options.title: Require exact-head replay
options.body: Keep the draft on hold until SHA-bound reconciliation counts, hashes, snapshot identities, and redacted final-candidate logs are attached.

options.title: Accept focused validation
options.body: Approve the new release workflow based on focused suites despite the absent authoritative historical replay.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head replay
recommendation.body: Keep the draft on hold until SHA-bound reconciliation counts, hashes, snapshot identities, and redacted final-candidate logs are attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned feature owner is best positioned to produce and explain the final reconciliation, with steipete as the strongest adjacent release-workflow reviewer.
